kind: static authored record; asserted by runtime/tests/run-compositing.ts and never rewritten by a test run

upscale_limit.justification: At an enlargement factor of 2, three of every four displayed pixels are interpolated rather than sampled from the source; beyond it a close-up cannot honestly claim detail the source does not contain.

worked_example.rounding: Crop dimensions are floored from the exact aspect box; the crop origin is rounded to the nearest pixel (halves up) inside the proven feasible interval; protected regions convert from normalized coordinates rounding outward (floor origin, ceil far edge); boxes mapped to the canvas round outward so protection checks never round into a pass.
